en.headline: Lee Cheuk Yiu and Ng Wing Lun meet in China Masters final
en.dek: The two Hong Kong shuttlers will contest the Super 750 men's singles title in Shenzhen this afternoon after both upset higher-ranked opponents on Saturday.
body: Lee Cheuk Yiu and Ng Wing Lun will face each other in the men's singles final of the China Masters in Shenzhen on Sunday, the first time two Hong Kong players have met in a BWF Super 750 singles final. The Super 750 tournament runs through 6 September at Shenzhen Gymnasium, with the finals session scheduled from 1pm.

Lee, ranked about 25th in the world, beat France's world No. 2 Christo Popov 21-15, 21-19 in Saturday's semi-final. He had earlier knocked out Popov's older brother, Toma Junior Popov. Local reports said it was Lee's first world-tour final in more than a year and a half, after the India Open in January 2025.

Ng, 22, playing his first Super 750 event, came back from a set down to beat fifth seed Anders Antonsen of Denmark 15-21, 22-20, 21-16 in a match lasting 98 minutes. On his way to the final he also beat world No. 1 Jonatan Christie of Indonesia and China's Weng Hongyang. Ng told Wen Wei Po the result lifted confidence ahead of the Asian Games.

Lee said after reaching the final that he was glad to meet his teammate there and that neither player should feel pressure over who wins. The all-Hong Kong final means the territory will take both the gold and silver medals in the men's singles draw.

zh.headline: 李卓耀吳英倫會師中國大師賽男單決賽
zh.dek: 兩名港將周六先後爆冷擊敗更高排名對手，今日下午在深圳爭奪超級750男單冠軍，亦是港隊首次包辦此級別單打決賽席位。
body: 李卓耀與吳英倫今日將在深圳體育館舉行的中國羽毛球大師賽男單決賽對決，成為香港首次有兩名球員會師世界羽聯超級750級別單打決賽。賽事於九月一日至六日舉行，決賽時段由下午一時開始。
世界排名約二十五的李卓耀周六準決賽以二十一比十五、二十一比十九直落兩局擊敗世界第二、法國的基斯度波波夫。他較早亦淘汰波波夫胞兄小托馬波波夫。本地報道指，這是李卓耀逾一年半以來再闖世界巡迴賽決賽，對上一場決賽是二零二五年一月的印度公開賽。
二十二歲的吳英倫首次出戰超級750賽事，準決賽先失一局後以十五比二十一、二十二比二十、二十一比十六反勝五號種子、丹麥的安東森，耗時九十八分鐘。他晉級途中亦擊敗世界第一印尼的基斯迪及中國的翁泳陽。吳英倫向《文匯報》表示，成績有助提升亞運前的信心。
李卓耀賽後表示，能與隊友會師決賽感到高興，無論誰勝誰負都無需有壓力。港隊包辦男單決賽，意味男單金銀牌都將由香港選手取得。
